option_estimates.snapshot_coverage: Every journey and demo records its options, estimates, intervals, harms, combinability, endpoints, sources, 30-year projections and patient-view horizon.
option_estimates.changes_in_v6: BP effect credited for at most 20 mmHg (224 of 738 snapshots changed; largest 10-year BP relative reduction 60% to 35%); aspirin kidney caution shown beside the bleeding figure; Ference long-exposure formula cited to Eur Heart J 2017;38:2459.
option_estimates.changes_since_v6_release: Catalog unchanged (option_effects_v6). Options are now gated by the engine (modules/actions/plan_options.py, application PR #140): statin start/intensify follow statin-therapy and intolerance determinations, SGLT2 and GLP-1 follow the engine decisions; the statin effect uses the engine lipid basis, including non-HDL-C when triglycerides are 200-399 mg/dL or calculated LDL-C is below 70 (PR #143).

priorities: Independent clinician adjudication of prespecified cases
Patient understanding and sustained clinician use
clinical_evaluation.scope: Software verification is reported separately from independent clinical evaluation.

evidence_scope: Counts represent software tests and synthetic journeys, not clinical study participants.
Historical semantic reviews remain bound to their recorded source revision and driver.
Independent clinical usefulness, prospective benefit and calibration of the RCCKM-specific frameworks remain evaluation priorities.

implementation_changes.scope: Consistent provenance-checked unrounded PREVENT cutoffs at 3%, 5% and 10%; minimum Level 3A for Intermediate 10-year ASCVD risk. Treatment pathways remain independent.
Metformin state on the clinician note, EMR line and roadmap.
CAC 0 noncalcified-plaque note when a recognized exception keeps lipid treatment in play.
Finerenone state on the EMR kidney line and patient roadmap.
Medication safety: metformin renal alert, potassium in ACEi/ARB advice, inactive antiplatelets.
Missing age or sex makes the Level incomplete; CAC 0 policy owns A1c >=6.5% and LDL-C 160-189 rules; A1c rounding never crosses a threshold.
Simulator options follow the engine gate and LDL-C validity.
Non-HDL-C 190-219 as a major risk enhancer; non-HDL-C simulator basis; non-HDL-C on the targets card.
2026 ACC/AHA optional intensified goals by CAC; graded incidental CAC.
Incidental CAC only strengthens lipid goals and statin advice.
Take-home plan v3: roadmap numbers and tests on the phone.
Five CKM assessments as tags on existing lines: FIB-4, KFRE, pre-heart failure, primary aldosteronism, AF stroke prevention (CHA2DS2-VASc). Three snapshot files changed; physician-owner approved.

pending_changes.scope: Probability-first Next.js assessment; separate disease/plaque, prioritized drivers and input availability; legacy codes in technical details; one-decimal probability display. Existing exported reports retain their codes.
